_comment: atelier mutation testing for this workspace folder alone: run from this folder (bun run mutate, bun run mutate:changed). See skills/atelier/references/workflow.md (Mutation testing).
_packageManager_comment: Stryker does not fully understand Bun yet; tell it npm so it does not probe for yarn or pnpm lockfiles.
_commandRunner_comment: Only the summary reaches Stryker. It keeps every killed mutant's whole process output as its status reason and serialises all of them into one report; on GitHub Actions bun test lists every test (1.2 MB a run on 2026-09-03), so a thousand killed mutants pushed JSON.stringify past V8's string limit (RangeError: Invalid string length) after the score had already passed. pipefail keeps bun's exit code, which is what decides killed vs survived.
_mutate_comment: src/domain and src/use-cases only. Test files have no logic to mutate; ports/ files are type-only (zero mutable code).
_incremental_comment: The incremental file keeps a full bun run mutate fast. mutate:changed and mutate:staged point Stryker at a new, empty incremental file for each run, because a shared file folds old results into the score (see scripts/mutate-changed.sh).
_ignorePatterns_comment: The sandbox needs the sources and their tests only. bunfig.toml stays out: its preload path is relative to this folder and does not resolve from the sandbox.
